import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Modular {
        long val;

        public Modular() {
            this.val = 0;
        }

        public <U> Modular(U v) {
            long value = 0;
            if (v instanceof Integer) {
                value = (Integer) v;
            } else if (v instanceof Long) {
                value = (Long) v;
            }
            this.val = value % getMod();
            if (this.val < 0) this.val += getMod();
        }

        public static long getMod() {
            return MOD;
        }

        public static Modular one() {
            return new Modular(1);
        }

        public static Modular zero() {
            return new Modular(0);
        }

        public static Modular fromProb(double p) {
            return new Modular((long) (p * getMod()));
        }

        public static Modular fromInt(int v) {
            return new Modular(v);
        }

        public static Modular fromLong(long v) {
            return new Modular(v);
        }

        public static Modular operatorAdd(Modular a, Modular b) {
            return a.add(b);
        }

        public static Modular operatorSubtract(Modular a, Modular b) {
            return a.subtract(b);
        }

        public static Modular operatorMultiply(Modular a, Modular b) {
            return a.multiply(b);
        }

        public static Modular operatorDivide(Modular a, Modular b) {
            return a.divide(b);
        }

        public Modular add(Modular other) {
            long res = this.val + other.val;
            if (res >= getMod()) res -= getMod();
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        public Modular subtract(Modular other) {
            long res = this.val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += getMod();
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        public Modular multiply(Modular other) {
            long res = (this.val * other.val) % getMod();
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        public Modular pow(long p) {
            Modular result = Modular.one();
            Modular base = this;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public Modular inv() {
            // Using Extended Euclidean Algorithm
            long a = this.val, m = getMod();
            long m0 = m, t, q;
            long x0 = 0, x1 = 1;

            if (m == 1) return new Modular(0);

            while (a > 1) {
                q = a / m;
                t = m;
                m = a % m;
                a = t;
                t = x0;
                x0 = x1 - q * x0;
                x1 = t;
            }

            if (x1 < 0) x1 += m0;
            return new Modular(x1);
        }

        public Modular divide(Modular other) {
            return this.multiply(other.inv());
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            if (!(obj instanceof Modular)) return false;
            return this.val == ((Modular) obj).val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Long.hashCode(val);
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(val);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int size = n * n;
        Modular[] prob = new Modular[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int p = sc.nextInt();
            prob[i] = Modular.fromProb(p / 100.0);
        }

        int mid = n / 2;
        int[] mask_vals = new int[1 << 6];
        int count_mask = 0;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 6); mask++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(mask) == mid) {
                mask_vals[mask] = count_mask++;
            } else {
                mask_vals[mask] = -1;
            }
        }

        List<Modular> total = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(1 << count_mask, Modular.zero()));

        // process function
        // l, r: range
        // handle: lambda to process match_sets and total_prob
        class Processor {
            void process(int l, int r, BiConsumer<Integer, Modular> handle) {
                int len = r - l;
                int totalEdges = 1 << (len * n);
                for (int edge_mask = 0; edge_mask < totalEdges; edge_mask++) {
                    Modular total_prob = Modular.one();
                    int tmp = edge_mask;
                    boolean skipEdge = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i < len * n; i++) {
                        if ((tmp & 1) == 1) {
                            total_prob = total_prob.multiply(prob[l * n + i]);
                        } else {
                            total_prob = total_prob.multiply(Modular.one().subtract(prob[l * n + i]));
                        }
                        if (total_prob.equals(Modular.zero())) {
                            skipEdge = true;
                            break;
                        }
                        tmp >>= 1;
                    }
                    if (skipEdge) continue;

                    char[] data = new char[3];
                    Arrays.fill(data, (char) 0);
                    int match_sets = 0;

                    while (true) {
                        int match_mask = 0;
                        boolean skipMatch = false;
                        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                            int index = i * n + data[i];
                            if (((edge_mask >> index) & 1) == 0) {
                                skipMatch = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (((match_mask) & (1 << data[i])) != 0) {
                                skipMatch = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            match_mask |= 1 << data[i];
                        }
                        if (skipMatch) {
                            // increment data
                            for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                                if (data[i] == n - 1) {
                                    data[i] = 0;
                                } else {
                                    data[i]++;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (r == n) {
                            match_mask ^= (1 << n) - 1;
                        }
                        match_sets |= 1 << mask_vals[match_mask];

                        // increment data
                        for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                            if (data[i] == n - 1) {
                                data[i] = 0;
                            } else {
                                data[i]++;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // process(0, mid, ...)
        class ProcessorInstance extends Processor {
            void run() {
                process(0, mid, (s, p) -> {
                    total.set(s, total.get(s).add(p));
                });
            }
        }

        ProcessorInstance processor1 = new ProcessorInstance();
        processor1.run();

        // accumulate total
        int sizeTotal = total.size();
        for (int i = 1; i < sizeTotal; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sizeTotal; j++) {
                if ((j & i) == 0) {
                    total.set(j | i, total.get(j | i).add(total.get(j)));
                }
            }
        }

        Modular res = Modular.zero();

        // process(mid, n, ...)
        class ProcessorInstance2 extends Processor {
            void run() {
                process(mid, n, (s, p) -> {
                    res = res.add(p.multiply(total.get(total.size() - 1 - s)));
                });
            }
        }

        ProcessorInstance2 processor2 = new ProcessorInstance2();
        processor2.run();

        System.out.println(res.val);
        sc.close();
    }
}
